titel: Fräulein Stassi, Short-Form Cringe & Muted Accounts

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen (Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst podtrac.com) - zu wenig fuer ein Urteil, aber nicht nichts

einzeiler: Austria adventures, Instagram etiquette, and the realities of reality TV filming.
kurzfassung: The hosts recount their experiences filming in Austria, including the perils of rocky lakes and Austrian carnivals. They discuss social media etiquette surrounding unfollowing, blocking, and muting accounts. Additionally, they reflect on fashion trends, personal identity, and the pressures of being on reality television.
stichpunkte: Filming in Austria brings unexpected challenges like terrible Wi-Fi and lack of loud children.
Swimming in European lakes involves navigating sharp rocks and muddy bottoms instead of sandy beaches.
Unfollowing and blocking on Instagram carry hidden etiquette rules and potential drama.
Muting stories is presented as a polite alternative to unfollowing people.
Fashion discussions cover upcoming trends like fringe, capes, and the polarizing color purple.
Reflecting on reality TV, the hosts discuss how editing strips away nuance and creates one-dimensional personas.
Bo's unexpected bout with mild shingles in Austria leads to quarantine and Victorian-era jokes.

kapitel.titel: Instagram Etiquette: Unfollowing, Blocking, and Muting
Fashion Trends: Purple, Capes, and Ugly Shoes
Reality TV Realities and Separation Anxiety

beschreibung:
Real besties catch up even when they’re across the world living it up in the Austrian countryside. This week, Stassi joins Taylor to unpack the surreal experience of living out a Sound of Music fantasy all while being sabotaged by terrible Wi-Fi and terrifying lakes. Meanwhile in LA, Taylor refuses to return a petty Instagram UNfollow and delivers us all a VERY important masterclass in modern social media etiquette. The duo breaks down the weaponizing of out-of-context clips, the fall fashion forecast (defending fugly flats) and Beau’s dramatic quarantine. Lastly, Stassi's separation anxiety fuels a solo flight she's soon taking to LA to present at the Creative Arts Emmys. As they say.. So long, farewell..
